fusions.name: Roll and Drown
fusions.desc: Clamps onto the target for 16 water damage, using up every affliction you have on it for 60% more damage each, and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Out of the Shallows
fusions.desc: Lunges at a target up to 4 tiles away and deals 8 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full range, leaving it 30% slower for 2 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Playing Dead
fusions.desc: Veils you for 10 seconds: enemies notice you 70% later. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Still Water
fusions.desc: When you have gone a while without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 5 seconds, once every 10 seconds. You have 20% more critical hit chance against an enemy that has not been hurt yet.
